items.title: Broadcom 與華爾街大佬合作達成 63B 美元協議，為 Anthropic 的 AI 硬體提供動力
items.originalTitle: Broadcom Partners With Wall Street Bigwigs To Forge $63B Deal To Power Anthropic’s AI Hardware
items.originalSummary: A syndicate of premier financial institutions created a dedicated special purpose vehicle (SPV) to buy Broadcom custom AI processors and networking gear, which will be leased directly to Anthropic. Bank of America, Citigroup, and Morgan Stanley are arranging the first-lien senior debt; Blackstone is providing the second-lien financing.Shipments of the Broadcom XPU AI accelerators and networking equipment are expected to start in calendar year 2027 under a previously announced compute capacity agreement. A consortium of major Wall Street financial institutions and chipmaker Broadcom Inc. (AVGO) announced a landmark $63 billion financing arrangement Monday to supply hardware to artificial intelligence startup Anthropic.The agreement brings together Bank of America Corp.(BAC), Blackstone Inc.(BX), Citigroup Inc.(C), and Morgan Stanley (MS) to fund the capital-heavy hardware essential for training and running next-generation artificial intelligence models.Under the terms of the deal, the consortium formed a special purpose vehicle (SPV), which will use the capital to purchase Broadcom's specialized XPU AI accelerators and high-speed networking solutions. The hardware will then be leased to Anthropic, with deliveries slated to commence in calendar year 2027.AVGO stock added about 1.3% after-hours on Monday. Who Is Paying?The transaction uses a layered credit structure to balance risk and scale. Bank of America, Citi, and Morgan Stanley are serving as lead arrangers for the first lien portion of the debt. Alternative asset manager Blackstone is acting as the sole provider for the committed second lien portion.The primary claim, or first lien, takes precedence over the second lien during asset liquidation, ensuring initial debts are fully settled."Financing AI demands capital solutions at unprecedented scale," said Vis Raghavan, head of banking and executive vice chair at Citi, highlighting the unprecedented financial requirements of current technology developments.Scaling Infrastructure Amid Rising DemandThe agreement underscores the massive capital outlay required to build out global AI computing infrastructure. As software developers seek greater computing capacity, chip suppliers and cloud operators are increasingly turning to Wall Street to fund server and hardware acquisitions.Broadcom’s initiative reflects growing momentum among semiconductor producers to challenge industry leader Nvidia Corp (NVDA), which also made similar arrangements earlier this year."Fundamentally, the need for AI compute continues to grow at an extraordinary pace," Broadcom President and Chief Executive Officer Hock Tan said in a statement. "This validates that there is capital available to finance such growth and that Broadcom is uniquely positioned to enable it."AVGO Stock: Retail View Retail sentiment on Stocktwits was ‘bearish’ with ‘normal’ message volumes. AVGO stock has lost about 6% year-to-date.For updates and corrections, email newsroom[at]stocktwits[dot]com.

items.originalTitle: AMZN Maintained by UBS -- Price Target Raised to $348
items.originalSummary: On Monday, October 26, UBS analyst Stephen Ju assigned a ‘Buy’ rating to Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ) stock , while also increasing his 12-month price target from $318 to $348. According to the note, the decision to forecast a 40.08% upside from $248.43 at press time rather than the previous 28% was largely rooted in the Amazon Web Services (AWS) margin increase expectations. Specifically, the Wall Street analyst explained that strong incremental revenue can outpace operating expense growth, which is needed to offset pressures related to artificial intelligence ( AI ). AI capital expenditures (CapEx) have been in focus since 2026, as a mix of dubious profitability and skyrocketing costs has generated doubts about the sustainability of the technology and seemingly compelled multiple blue-chip giants to issue new equity. Amazon likewise came under scrutiny earlier in October when it was revealed that the company remains unable to install the hardware it acquired for artificial intelligence data centers due to a lack of energy. The news was especially concerning due to the company lacking a clear installation timetable and the relatively short useful life of advanced GPUs. Meanwhile, Wall Street remained largely unfazed by the recent developments. Indeed, AMZN shares are, overall, considered a ‘Strong Buy’ by institutional experts and boast forty-two positive, two ‘Hold’, and no ‘Sell’ recommendations, per the data Finbold retrieved from TipRanks on October 26. The average Amazon stock price target for the next 12 months is similarly optimistic and estimates the equity will rally 32.89% to $331.54 within the timeframe. Lastly, AMZN shares have been experiencing significant volatility through most of 2026 and, despite being 10.22% in the green year-to-date (YTD), they have generally been declining since early August and have dropped 12.14% within the timeframe.

items.originalSummary: SINGAPORE and AMSTERDAM, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SWI Compute today emerged from stealth to build and operate NVIDIA AI factories, launching first in Europe. The global AI infrastructure company is backed by 3.6 gigawatts of power capacity that SWI Group has spent six years securing across Europe and the US. The new company of Euronext Amsterdam-listed SWI Group became a Preferred NVIDIA Cloud Partner in August, ordered approximately $1 billion of NVIDIA systems and has finalized contracts with its first customers. SWI Compute will deploy globally, with the strongest presence and deployments in Europe. Its first large-scale AI factory in the UK starts with 30 MW, close to 7,000 Rubin GPUs and 3,500 Vera CPUs in NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 racks, expected to come online by the end of 2027. Connected by NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand and NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking, these 30 MW are the initial phase of a UK campus planned to grow to 530 MW, and the first step towards 2.3 GW of NVIDIA AI factory capacity by 2029.

items.originalTitle: Nasdaq, Treasury yields and dollar face a major AI sentiment test
items.originalSummary: Asian technology shares fell on Tuesday as investors assessed fresh pressure on the artificial intelligence trade ahead of major US corporate earnings. South Korea’s Kospi Index dropped 3.9%, while chipmaker SK Hynix headed toward its lowest closing level since April. The MSCI Asia Pacific Index lost 1.4%, reversing the direction of Monday’s technology-led gains on Wall Street. Nasdaq 100 futures also weakened, and the dollar slipped against major currencies as traders weighed higher financing costs and rising oil prices.Bloomberg reported that the pullback followed a brief US technology recovery that failed to lift the wider stock market. Upcoming results from major companies now offer a test of investor confidence in AI spending and the demand supporting semiconductor shares..South Korean Chip Shares Lead Asian Market Decline.South Korea bore the sharpest losses as chip shares extended their retreat. The local market serves as a key gauge of investor appetite for companies linked to artificial intelligence infrastructure. At the same time, data-center company Elice plunged as much as 33% during its Seoul trading debut.Elsewhere, Japan’s Topix fell 1.5%, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng declined 1.2%, and the Shanghai Composite lost 0.6%. The MSCI Emerging Markets Index also dropped 1.2%, while Euro Stoxx 50 futures indicated a 0.7% decline at the European open.The broad regional weakness contrasted with Monday’s US trading. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained 1.6%, ending an eight-session losing streak, its longest since 2008. The advance helped the Nasdaq 100 recover after its weakest week since April 2025’s tariff-related turmoil.Still, the recovery remained concentrated in technology. Roughly 65% of S&P 500 members finished Monday lower, according to the market report. That imbalance showed how gains among a small group of stocks differed from conditions across the wider market..AI Earnings Face Scrutiny as Funding Costs Rise.Investors now face several earnings announcements that could reshape expectations for technology companies. Netflix reports Tuesday, followed Wednesday by Tesla, Meta Platforms and IBM. Their updates arrive after heavy AI spending and rising borrowing costs unsettled technology shares.Can the coming earnings reports sustain confidence in the AI investment boom? The question follows fresh concern about financing large computing projects. In Asia, SoftBank’s credit-default swap spreads rose to their highest level in nearly four years amid funding concerns and talk of a major acquisition.Meanwhile, Nscale entered talks over a reported USD 45 billion computing arrangement with Anthropic. The discussions showed the scale of proposed infrastructure commitments even as investors reassessed borrowing costs and the financial outlook for AI-related businesses.Treasury markets reflected that pressure. The US 10-year yield eased two basis points to 5.12% after Monday’s rise, when reduced demand for safer assets pushed yields higher. historyItems.originalTitle: Nuclear Fuel Capacity Expands via Centrus Energy Westerman Acquisition
historyItems.originalSummary: Interested in Centrus Energy Corp.? Here are five stocks we like better. Centrus Energy completed a $116 million acquisition of Westerman Holdings on Oct. 16 to secure its primary centrifuge-component manufacturing supply chain. Despite falling nearly 55% year-to-date on dilution concerns from a $500 million stock offering, Centrus holds a $3.7 billion uranium enrichment backlog and a $900 million Department of Energy contract. Zacks Research upgraded Centrus to Strong-Buy with a consensus price target near $225, implying over 100% upside as nuclear fuel demand grows.

historyItems.summary: Investing.com—彭博新聞社報導，SpaceX 正在討論獲得美國至少 80,000 個蜂窩基地台的接入權，該公司股價週五在美國盤前交易中上漲超過 2%。彭博社報道稱，此舉將標誌著朝著建立第四家全國性無線營運商邁出了具體的一步。據稱，這家衛星巨頭正在與包括 Crown Castle International Corp （NYSE：CCI）在內的主要塔營運商進行談判，以收集補充其軌道網路所需的實體基礎設施。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX in Talks to Access 80,000 Cell Sites for New Network
historyItems.originalSummary: Investing.com -- SpaceX shares rose by more than 2% in premarket U.S. trading on Friday after Bloomberg News reported that the rocket company is in discussions to secure access to at least 80,000 cell sites across the United States. Bloomberg reported that the move would signal a concrete step toward establishing a fourth nationwide wireless carrier. The satellite giant is said to be negotiating with major tower operators, including Crown Castle International Corp (NYSE:CCI), as it gathers the physical infrastructure required to complement its orbital network. Crown Castle shares surged by more than 7% premarket.

historyItems.originalTitle: Purdue, GlobalFoundries expand partnership with master research agreement
historyItems.originalSummary: WEST LAFAYETTE, Ind. (WLFI) - Purdue University has announced a master research agreement with GlobalFoundries, a manufacturer of essential semiconductors. Purdue says the agreement will significantly expand the university’s research capabilities, and bolster the talent pipeline in the semi-conductor ecosystem. The agreement builds upon a strategic partnership first announced in November 2022. Purdue says it will create a streamlined framework for multiple collaborative projects. Under the unified framework, Purdue says the agreement enables new research initiatives to launch quickly and efficiently, accelerating innovation in semiconductor technology. Since 2023, GlobalFoundries has hosted students from Purdue’s summer training, awareness, and readiness for semiconductors program at its U.S. headquarters.

historyItems.originalTitle: TTM Technologies Fiscal Q3 non-GAAP Earnings, Revenue Rise; Initiates Fiscal 2027 Preliminary Outlook
historyItems.originalSummary: Interested in TTM Technologies, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better. TTM Technologies delivered record third-quarter results: Revenue rose 60% year over year to $1.2 billion, while non-GAAP earnings per share more than doubled to $1.46. Adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 20.1% from 16.1%, driven by stronger volume, favorable product mix and execution gains. Data Center & Networking led growth, with sales up 115% and accounting for 41% of revenue, as demand increased for higher-value N+M circuit boards. Aerospace and defense also remained strong, with a record $2 billion backlog and a 1.6 book-to-bill ratio. TTM raised its 2026 outlook to $4.47 billion-$4.49 billion in revenue and issued preliminary 2027 guidance of $6.5 billion-$6.75 billion. The company is planning an additional $400 million capacity investment and pursuing acquisitions, including the proposed $650 million purchase of Ophir Optics.

historyItems.title: IBM 股價盤後上漲，軟體實力和延遲合約恢復超過第三季營收預期
historyItems.summary: 國際商業機器公司 IBM 公佈了強勁的 2026 年第三季業績，調整後收益年增 11% 至每股 2.95 美元。該數字比 Zacks 的普遍預期 2.88 美元高出 2.4%。營收成長 4.7%，達到 171 億美元，比市場預期的 168.7 億美元高出 1.4%。上行反映了軟體和基礎設施成長的加速、交易執行和生產力計劃的改善。
historyItems.originalTitle: IBM Stock Rises After-Hours, Tops Q3 Revenue Estimates On Software Strength And Recovery In Delayed Contracts
historyItems.originalSummary: International Business Machines Corporation IBM reported strong third-quarter 2026 results, with adjusted earnings rising 11% year over year to $2.95 per share. The figure beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $2.88 by 2.4%. Revenues increased 4.7% to $17.10 billion, surpassing the consensus mark of $16.87 billion by 1.4%. The upside reflected accelerating Software and Infrastructure growth, improved transaction execution and productivity initiatives. Software annual recurring revenue (ARR) reached $24.9 billion, up 8% year over year. Operating pre-tax margin expanded 70 basis points (bps).

historyItems.summary: 營收：82.2億美元，季增22%，年增54%；連續第五個季度營收創紀錄。毛利率：由於良好的客戶和產品組合，達到創紀錄的 52.4%，高於 6 月季度的 52%。營業利益率：創紀錄的 40.2%，高於 6 月季度的 38.4%；首次突破40%。稀釋後每股盈餘：創紀錄的 2.20 美元；稀釋後股數約12.6億。
historyItems.originalTitle: LRCX: Record revenue and earnings, with December-quarter guidance for $8.60B revenue
historyItems.originalSummary: Revenue: $8.22 billion, up 22% sequentially and 54% year-over-year; fifth consecutive quarter of record revenue. Gross Margin: Record 52.4%, up from 52% in the June quarter on favorable customer and product mix. Operating Margin: Record 40.2%, up from 38.4% in the June quarter; first time topping 40%. Diluted EPS: Record $2.20; diluted share count ~1.26 billion. Operating Expenses: $1 billion, up from $916 million prior quarter; R&D ~two-thirds of total. Deferred Revenue: $2.66 billion, up $227 million from the June quarter. Memory Systems Revenue: 46% of systems revenue (record dollar level), up 120% year-over-year; NAND 26% of systems revenue (up from 23%), NAND dollars up ~40% sequentially; DRAM 20% of systems revenue (down from 23%), record dollar level. Foundry Systems Revenue: Record; 46% of systems revenue, up from 44% in the June quarter. Logic and Other Systems Revenue: 8% of systems revenue, down from 10% in the June quarter. CSBG Revenue: Fourth consecutive record quarter at nearly $2.5 billion, up slightly sequentially and 40% year-over-year; calendar 2026 growth expected above 30% year-over-year, with over 15% growth expected in calendar 2027.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX earnings left one big question unanswered
historyItems.originalSummary: The moment is now for Elon Musk to dial back founder mode at SpaceX ( SPCX ) and dial back up something else he is very good at: charming visionary founder who is asking for large sums of capital from people who want entry to the Muskverse. Because judging by Musk's commentary on his late Tuesday earnings call, he will need a lot of fresh capital to deliver on aggressive growth timelines for Terrafab, Starlink broadband and rocket reusability. Perhaps way more than most investors think.

historyItems.originalTitle: Meta Q3 earnings to test Wall Street's stomach for AI spending
historyItems.originalSummary: Meta ( META ) kicked off Big Tech's earnings season after the bell Wednesday, beating expectations on revenue, but GAAP earnings per share took a hit as a result of legal fees related to its teen mental health settlement. The company also announced a 2-for-1 stock split, giving each owner of Class A Meta shares a non-voting Class C share. Meta stock fell 0.5% during premarket trading on Thursday.

historyItems.title: 為什麼馬斯克想要合併 SpaceX 和特斯拉
historyItems.summary: 馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 花了數年時間將特斯拉和 SpaceX 打造成兩個價值數萬億美元的科技帝國。現在，他正在考慮讓他們在一起。週二被問及合併是否是一個好主意時，馬斯克明確表示：「是的。」前景不僅僅是假設。馬斯克表示，已經成立了特別委員會來評估潛在的交易，但他強調，不能保證合併一定會發生，也沒有達成任何協議。
historyItems.originalTitle: Why Elon Musk Wants to Merge SpaceX and Tesla
historyItems.originalSummary: Elon Musk has spent years building Tesla and SpaceX into a pair of trillion-dollar technology empires. Now, he is considering bringing them together . Asked on Tuesday whether a merger would be a good idea, Musk was clear: "Yes." The prospect is more than hypothetical. Musk said special committees have been formed to assess a potential deal, although he stressed that there is no guarantee a merger will happen and that nothing has been agreed.

historyItems.title: SpaceX 與特斯拉可能合併嗎？這就是人們所說的
historyItems.summary: 伊隆馬斯克在周二的第三季財報電話會議上表示，特斯拉和 SpaceX 已經成立了特別委員會來討論可能的合併。擔任兩家公司執行長的馬斯克表示，特別委員會是應股東的要求成立的，由獨立董事組成（儘管他沒有透露姓名）。他還指出，他不是這兩個委員會的成員，也沒有參與任何討論。 「因為我是一個衝突方，所以我實際上無法參與特別委員會的討論，」馬斯克說。
historyItems.originalTitle: A possible SpaceX-Tesla merger? Here's what people are saying
historyItems.originalSummary: Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a possible merger, Elon Musk said during the latter’s third quarter earnings call Tuesday. Musk, who serves as CEO of both companies, said the special committees were formed at the request of shareholders and consist of independent directors (though he did not name them). He also noted that he is not a member of either committee, nor involved in any of the discussions. “Because I’m a conflicted party, I can’t actually be in the discussions of the special committees,” Musk said. “So it’s an odd kabuki dance where two groups of people are talking and I can’t be in the conversation.” The groups have not reached agreement on the terms of any transaction — and there’s no guarantee that they will. “At the end of the day, the shareholders have to be supportive of this,” he continued. “And particularly on the Tesla side, we will need a 50 percent vote of all shares, not just those who vote, but of all shareholders. And that’s quite a high hurdle to try to achieve.” That said, Musk called the possibility of a Tesla-SpaceX merger a “good idea.” He continued: > I do think there’s a lot of merit to combining companies as we are pretty much in the superintelligence singularity. And there’s a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing superintelligence software, chip design, the TeraFab, obviously robotics, mass to orbit with the Starmind constellation, connectivity. So I think it would be a good idea, but it’s really up to the special committees of both companies. They’ve got to come up with something and then that’s going to be put to the shareholders as a vote. A Tesla-SpaceX merger would be a blockbuster corporate deal creating a mega-entity valued upwards of $3.6 trillion. But combining Musk’s car and energy company with his AI and rocket company would not be without its tradeoffs. A lot depends on which company absorbs the other. To buy SpaceX, Tesla would have to create millions of new stock shares, which for current Tesla owners would mean owning a smaller slice of a much larger pie. SpaceX’s launch goals require tens of billions of dollars every year — extra spending that could drain Tesla’s ability to build new car factories and battery plants. That said, most Wall Street analysts and legal experts believe SpaceX would acquire Tesla (or absorb it through a stock swap) rather than vice versa. Since its IPO, SpaceX has maintained a higher valuation than Tesla. A merger in that direction would allow SpaceX shareholders to hold the majority control of the combined mega-entity. Some Tesla shareholders may balk at this deal. But it would also create one company for those who believe in Musk’s vision of the future — robot cars, humanoid robots, AI super-intelligence, and human habitats on Mars — in which to place their investments. And Tesla shareholder approved Musk’s enormous pay package last year — even after a Delaware judge tossed it over lack of independence. Earlier this month, Barclays published a client note suggesting a potential Tesla-SpaceX combination could be announced ahead of Tesla’s annual shareholder meeting scheduled for December 3, 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Tesla and SpaceX Formed Committees to Discuss Potential Merger, Elon Musk Says
historyItems.originalSummary: Wall Street is sounding bullish on SpaceX ahead of its third-quarter earnings report, to be delivered after the bell on Tuesday. Mizuho has an outperform rating on the stock and a $200 price target, per a Monday note from analyst Brett Linzey. Shares were trading around $148 as of 10:45 a.m. on Tuesday. "AI is the largest swing factor for 3Q26 revenue and EBITDA. Consensus has AI revenue of $6.30B (+146% Q/Q from $2.56B) and AI adj. EBITDA of $3.32B (from $1.15B)," he wrote. Analysts are expecting some conversation about deals or competitive plays with cable and telecom companies following SpaceX's acquisition of low-band spectrum earlier this month. "We expect initial strategic commentary centers around Connectivity and how SPCX can partner/compete its way into global markets, although we think low-band distribution becomes a meaningful intelligence lever over time," Colin Canfield at Cantor Fitzgerald wrote in a Monday note. He has a price target of $246 and an overweight rating on the stock. Oppenheimer's expectations are more measured. The bank thinks the quarter will be "in-line" with "guidance reiterated." "Industry subscriber growth is slowing with limited room for pricing action, so focus is shifting from net adds and service revenue growth toward cost-cutting using AI, and lower subsidies/churn," Timothy Horan at Oppenheimer told clients in a Tuesday note. He expects "more rational incumbent behavior" from SpaceX's competitors. –Tobias Burns

historyItems.originalTitle: Space X and Tesla exploring merger, CEO Elon Musk says
historyItems.originalSummary: It's official: Tesla and SpaceX are in talks. Independent board members at the two Elon Musk-led companies have formed special committees to hash over a possible merger, Musk told investors during SpaceX's third-quarter earnings call Tuesday. "These special committees consist of independent directors, and because I'm a conflicted party, I can't actually be in the discussions of the special committees," said Musk, who was asked about a potential combination during the call. "This is definitely the kind of question where I feel like I'm tap dancing through a minefield."

Dell gained 7% and HPE 5%, but both trail SMCI because AI servers are a smaller slice of their diversified portfolios spanning PCs, storage, and networking.

investorBrief.event: Super Micro Computer 在 2027 財年第一季初步收入達到至少 185 億美元後，股價上漲 13%，突破了其指導範圍的上限。戴爾上漲了 7%，HPE 上漲了 5%，但兩者都落後於 SMCI，因為人工智慧伺服器在其涵蓋 PC、儲存和網路的多元化產品組合中所佔的份額較小。

historyItems.summary: 經過涉及近 1,000 次飛行和超過 2,000 飛行小時的測試計劃後，美國聯邦航空管理局 (FAA) 已對波音 737 MAX 10 進行了認證，這是 737 MAX 系列中最大的飛機。此次批准為波音在未來幾個月內開始交付 737-10 掃清了道路。該飛機最多可容納 230 名乘客，是該公司單通道 737 MAX 系列中載客量最高的機型。該認證經過了廣泛的安全評估、設計審查和地面測試。
historyItems.originalTitle: Boeing’s Large 737 Max Jet Secures U.S. Approval
historyItems.originalSummary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has certified Boeing’s 737 MAX 10, the largest aircraft in the 737 MAX family, following a testing program involving nearly 1,000 flights and more than 2,000 flight hours.The approval clears the path for Boeing to begin delivering the 737-10 in the coming months. The aircraft can accommodate up to 230 passengers, making it the highest-capacity model in the company’s single-aisle 737 MAX lineup.The certification follows extensive safety assessments, design reviews, and ground testing. Boeing said the program included 1,000 ground test hours, tens of thousands of pages of documentation and formal reviews with the FAA.The 737-10 is also the first commercial aircraft certified under the full requirements of the 2020 Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act. The law introduced stricter requirements for documenting aircraft safety assessments and evaluating how pilots interact with aircraft systems.New safety requirements applyWhat sets the aircraft apart is its enhanced angle-of-attack system, which Boeing plans to introduce across the 737 MAX family.Angle of attack refers to the angle between an aircraft wing and the airflow approaching it. The measurement helps pilots and onboard systems assess flight conditions, including the risk of an aerodynamic stall.Boeing says the upgraded system is designed to reduce pilot workload. Its introduction across the MAX family makes the 737-10 an important step in the company’s broader aircraft safety program.“Our flight test team ran a disciplined, methodical campaign to validate every system,” said Chris Payne, vice president and general manager of 737 Airplane Development Programs at Boeing Commercial Airplanes.Larger aircraft expands capacityThe 737-10 typically seats between 185 and 210 passengers in a two-class configuration, although its maximum seating capacity reaches 230.The aircraft has a range of up to 3,100 nautical miles (5,740 kilometers). Boeing also claims it offers the lowest cost per seat among single-aisle aircraft currently in service, although that comparison was not independently established in the announcement.According to Boeing, the aircraft offers 365 nautical miles more range than competing aircraft without auxiliary fuel tanks. The company also says technological improvements across the 737 MAX program reduce fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emissions by 20%, without specifying the comparison baseline in the announcement.Airline interest in the largest MAX variant is substantial. Boeing reported 1,555 orders from more than 30 customers, representing over 30 percent of the program’s outstanding orders.Across the broader 737 MAX family, customers have placed 7,350 orders, with nearly 2,500 aircraft delivered through September 2026. The FAA certified the smaller 737-7 earlier this year. With the 737-10 now approved, Boeing has secured certification for the final member of the MAX family.However, certification does not mean the aircraft has entered commercial service. Boeing expects customer deliveries to begin in the coming months.

historyItems.originalTitle: Boeing wins FAA approval for 737 Max 10 after years of delays as Duffy says certification process should be faster
historyItems.originalSummary: (Bloomberg) -- Boeing Co. won US regulator approval for its 737 Max 10 jet, capping off a lengthy certification saga for the planemaker’s family of narrowbody aircraft that was disrupted by two fatal crashes and a series of quality lapses.The 737 Max 10 is the largest of the company’s single-aisle aircraft and is Boeing’s response to rival Airbus SE’s A321neo. The plane’s 1,500-plus order book makes it one of the more popular Max variants, purchased by US carriers like United Airlines Holdings Inc. and Alaska Air Group Inc. The Max 10’s smallest sibling, the 737 Max 7, was approved by the US Federal Aviation Administration in August.“The FAA’s decision follows a thorough review of the aircraft’s design and safety requirements,” FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said in a news release, adding that the regulator will “continue to hold Boeing to the highest safety standards” moving forward.Bloomberg reported in July that the FAA was expected to certify the Max 10 around October. The timeline was briefly in doubt after the planemaker disclosed a software glitch with the airplane’s navigation system, but an FAA panel determined the issue did not pose a safety risk.“The 737-10 offers greater capacity, longer range and the best seat economics in its class, a platform that will create more value and opportunities for airlines around the world,” Boeing Commercial Airplanes Chief Executive Officer Stephanie Pope said in a statement Tuesday.The Max 10 is one of Boeing’s most important new jets, offering airlines a solution to replace the out-of-production 757. Alongside the other Max models, the largest variant will help the planemaker repair its balance sheet and pare down debt. The aircraft can seat as many as 230 passengers and fly for up to 3,100 nautical miles, according to Boeing’s website.US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said streamlining aircraft certification is essential to America’s ability to compete with Europe and China, noting that it took nearly a decade to approve the Max 10. “I have to allow you all to certify ​aircraft faster,” Duffy told a ceremony at Boeing’s widebody site north of Seattle on Tuesday. “You have to come to the market more quickly.”Regulators in Canada and Europe are expected to complete their own Max 10 approvals in “probably a couple months,” Mike Sinnett, a Boeing executive over development programs, said later.

historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile Advances Service Readiness Ahead of Initial Space-Based Cellular Broadband Coverage in Key Global Markets
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. announced it is advancing service readiness in key global markets before the end of 2026, including the United States, Canada, Japan, United Kingdom and Saudi Arabia. AST SpaceMobile now has more than 60 gateways deployed, installed, or in planning worldwide. The expansive ground network supports AST SpaceMobile?s global commercial ecosystem with over 60 mobile network operators who cover over 3 billion subscribers, bringing a third layer of connectivity directly into the mobile networks people already use.Spectrum is a key component of this readiness. AST SpaceMobile combines strategic partner operators? spectrum with access to mobile satellite services (MSS) spectrum, targeting approximately 100 MHz of access in the United States.Its spectrum position includes access to 45 MHz of MSS mid-band spectrum in North America and priority rights to 60 MHz of S-band spectrum globally on a market-by-market basis. The company?s satellite technology can tune across approximately 1,150 MHz of low- and mid-band frequencies globally, providing flexibility to serve different markets using available partner and satellite spectrum, subject to applicable regulatory approvals. Supporting this service rollout, AST SpaceMobile?s ground network connects the company?s growing satellite constellation with mobile operators?core networks, routing voice, video and broadband data between space and ground-based infrastructure, making it a key component of the end-to-end infrastructure required to deliver space-based cellular broadband connectivity through partners to people everywhere they work, live, and travel. This integration enables operators to extend their reach beyond the limits of terrestrial coverage while evolving alongside future 3GPP standards. In the United States, the Company has already enabled over 3,000 coverage cells and expects to activate the roughly 5,600 cellular cells that cover the continuous United States before year-end.Enabling the remaining digital cells will establish the geographic footprint required to support initial, intermittent service across the contiguous United States and is a prerequisite for nationwide rollout. During this initial phase, service will be available within the satellites? coverage area.Additional spacecraft deployments will extend the duration and frequency of coverage as AST SpaceMobile advances toward continuous service. BlueBird satellites are assembled, integrated, and tested at AST SpaceMobile?s facilities in Midland, Texas, with production now progressing through BlueBird 50. Service availability will expand as satellite capacity and ground infrastructure are deployed and network integration progresses, subject to applicable authorizations.

historyItems.originalTitle: Is Open AI Rack Launch Altering The Investment Case For Arista Networks Stock?
historyItems.originalSummary: Arista Networks recently launched an open Ethernet rack-scale portfolio, including the Etherlink SU-144 architecture, to support high-density AI infrastructure with up to 144 accelerators per rack and liquid-cooled designs tailored for extreme power and thermal demands. The ESUN-based platforms and Netdi foundation aim to give cloud and AI operators an open, standards-focused alternative to proprietary interconnects, linking Arista's hardware closely to neocloud cost-per-token priorities and multi-vendor AI compute ecosystems. This development also shapes Arista Networks' broader investment narrative, with a focus on the Etherlink SU-144 AI rack-scale expansion.

historyItems.originalTitle: GE Vernova secures order aimed to strengthen regional energy capacity in Côte d’Ivoire
historyItems.originalSummary: Developed by Songon Energies S.A., Songon power plant is built to strengthen energy security and support future growing electricity demand in Greater Abidjan GE Vernova 9E turbine technology to support reliable power delivery for industrial growth and millions of households Infrastructure development expected to create up to 1,400 new jobs and drive positive community impact ABIDJAN, Côte d'Ivoire - [October 20, 2026] - GE Vernova announced today that it will provide the gas power technology forthe new Songon combined-cycle power plant, located in the Songon region near Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire. Following the signing of financing agreements last June, Songon Energies- Ivorian development investment company focused on advancing energy infrastructure - selected GE Vernova to supply a 9E gas turbine and generator. The plant - to be built by the EPC contractor China Energy International Engineering Co., Ltd. - is expected to deliver 372 megawatts (MW), a capacity equal to the power needs of approximately 5 million Ivorian homes. Supporting a growing national energy landscape. Côte d'Ivoire has made significant progress, reaching an electrification rate of 94.3 percent by 2024 through initiatives like the "Electricity for All Program" (PEPT), in line with the national goal to achieve universal electrification and improved power quality by 2030. Despite these gains, the nation faces an annual demand growth rate of 10 to 15 percent and rural areas still require expanded access. In this energy landscape, this new power plant will help fill a critical gap. historyItems.originalTitle: Vishay Intertechnology (VSH) Launches New Sensors, Is It Still A Bargain?
historyItems.originalSummary: Highlights Vishay Intertechnology introduced automotive-grade optical sensors for battery management, energy storage and industrial automation applications. The sensors support high-speed, wear-free optical communication with electromagnetic interference immunity. The product launch expands the company's component offerings for electric vehicles, industrial equipment and other specialised electronic systems. Vishay Intertechnology (NYSE:VSH) operates in the semiconductor and electronic components sector, supplying products used in automotive systems, industrial equipment, computing hardware and other electronic applications. The company announced a new range of automotive-grade optical sensors designed for battery management, energy storage and industrial automation systems. The launch expands the company's offerings for applications that require reliable data communication in electrically demanding environments. Optical sensors can support communication between electronic components while reducing dependence on conventional electrical signalling in suitable system designs. The products are intended for applications where electromagnetic interference, operational reliability and communication integrity are important engineering considerations. Electric vehicles and automated manufacturing equipment contain multiple electronic subsystems that exchange information to monitor operating conditions and coordinate functions. Optical Sensors and High-Speed Communication The newly introduced sensors support high-speed, wear-free optical data communication. Optical communication uses light to transmit information, offering an alternative to electrical signalling in applications where electrical noise can affect signal integrity. Electromagnetic interference can arise from motors, switching circuits, power electronics and other electrical equipment. In electric vehicles, battery systems and power conversion hardware operate alongside control electronics, creating demanding conditions for signal transmission. Optical communication can help address some of these challenges by reducing susceptibility to electromagnetic interference along the optical communication path. The practical benefits depend on system architecture, component integration and the requirements of the application. The sensors are designed for mission-critical hardware environments, where dependable communication supports monitoring and control functions. Their wear-free communication approach also addresses applications in which contact-based transmission methods may introduce mechanical limitations. The product announcement identifies electromagnetic immunity and cybersecurity resilience as relevant design features. These characteristics align with the requirements of modern electronic systems, although actual system-level protection depends on implementation, software, network architecture and other safeguards. historyItems.originalTitle: AstraZeneca and Oracle launch global AI collaboration to advance clinical trial optimisation and support better patient outcomes
historyItems.originalSummary: Partnership aims to advance solutions to improve care pathways, clinical trial matching, safety monitoring, and guideline-directed care AstraZeneca and Oracle Health and Life Sciences today announced a unique collaboration to leverage AstraZeneca's scientific, clinical development and regulatory expertise with Oracle's real-world data, cloud infrastructure, and AI-enabled clinical capabilities to accelerate clinical research and bring evidence-driven insights into care workflows to accelerate clinical trial optimisation and help more patients receive the right care sooner. Many serious conditions are diagnosed late; patients can wait a long time before they are referred and there are gaps in how we translate scientific advancements into clinical practice. This collaboration is designed to test practical ways to connect scientific research directly to clinical workflows and transform care. Initial areas of exploration include clinical trial recruitment, earlier diagnosis, drug-safety monitoring and leveraging real-world evidence across the lifecycle of a medicine. Programmes will span AstraZeneca's core disease areas including oncology, cardiovascular, renal and metabolic diseases, respiratory and immunology, and rare disease. The collaboration will span multiple international projects with key regions including the US, Middle East, and Europe working with local governments and within applicable regulations to ensure these could be scaled in the future. The first programme will focus on supporting hypertension care and clinical research in Abu Dhabi, in partnership with healthcare company, M42. This will help clinical teams identify patients with uncontrolled hypertension; implementing guideline-directed care; and improving the recruitment for clinical trials. Pascal Soriot, Chief Executive Officer, AstraZeneca said: "This unique collaboration brings leaders in healthcare and AI together at a global scale to accelerate the journey from the discovery of medicine to patient care. Combining AstraZeneca's world class science with Oracle's deep data and technology expertise, we can help clinicians identify patients sooner, optimise clinical trials, and generate evidence continuously across the lifecycle of a medicine." Mike Sicilia, chief executive officer, Oracle said: "Some of the most important opportunities for AI are in healthcare, where better use of data can help turn scientific innovation into better outcomes for patients. By bringing AstraZeneca's scientific expertise together with Oracle's data, cloud, AI, and healthcare capabilities, we have an opportunity to help accelerate research, connect more patients to clinical trials, and ultimately bring relevant insights into care faster." Anne-Claire Gerbaldi, Chief Digital, Data and AI Officer, AstraZeneca, said: "Too many patients are diagnosed late or face a long journey to get the care they need. historyItems.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) 推出 OCP AI 系統並任命 Mark Long 為財務長
historyItems.summary: Super Micro Computer（納斯達克GS：SMCI）宣布推出基於開放運算專案的全新人工智慧和高效能運算資料中心解決方案，目標是機架規模部署。擴展後的 OCP 認可產品組合現已涵蓋用於節能、密集 AI 叢集的系統、機架、液體冷卻設備和網路硬體。該公司任命 Mark Long 為財務官，增加了西部數據和其他大型科技集團的高階主管財務經驗。基於 OCP 的人工智慧和 HPC 的推出，加上聘請 Mark Long 擔任財務官，與我們的研究標記的更廣泛的主題相一致。
historyItems.originalTitle: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Unveils OCP AI Systems And Names Mark Long CFO
historyItems.originalSummary: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) announced new Open Compute Project based AI and high performance computing data center solutions targeting rack scale deployments. The expanded OCP Accepted portfolio now covers systems, racks, liquid cooling gear, and networking hardware for energy efficient, dense AI clusters. The company named Mark Long as Chief Financial Officer, adding executive finance experience from Western Digital and other large tech groups. The OCP based AI and HPC rollout plus the hiring of Mark Long as CFO comes alongside wider themes our research has flagged. Our analysis turns up 2 warning signs (1 major) for Super Micro Computer as well. For readers tracking the build out of AI data center infrastructure, it is worth comparing Super Micro Computer with other hardware and tooling suppliers through 55 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.originalSummary: CoreWeave ( CRWV ) shares rose 3% before surrendering their gains Monday after Goldman Sachs upgraded the neocloud provider to Buy from Neutral. historyItems.originalTitle: Why Intel stock just got a big upgrade
historyItems.originalSummary: After a sweeping tech stock sell-off last week, Wall Street is on the hunt for bargains. And JPMorgan ( JPM ) may have found one in chip giant Intel ( INTC ), with the stock off about 36% from the June highs. Analyst Harlan Sur upgraded his rating on Intel to Neutral from Underweight on Monday. Intel stock rose more than 4% in early trading.

historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk says he will give a SpaceX share to ‘every kid in America’
historyItems.originalSummary: Elon Musk announced on social media Monday that he intends to give one SpaceX share to each child in the United States. The post described the move as the start of a larger series of gifts. Details on timing, eligibility, or distribution remain absent from the statement. ( [1] ) Musk, who serves as chief executive of SpaceX, posted the pledge without additional explanation or follow-up instructions. The message reached his large audience on the platform and quickly drew attention from news outlets and the public. Observers noted the unusual nature of committing personal holdings to a broad group of minors across the country.

historyItems.summary: AST SpaceMobile 和 TELUS 完成了整合測試，將 TELUS 的地面無線網路與 AST SpaceMobile 的天基系統連接起來，旨在為偏遠和服務欠缺地區的加拿大智慧型手機用戶擴展直接衛星連接。 AST SpaceMobile 正面臨發射時間表的不確定性以及來自 SpaceX 在頻譜接入和衛星部署方面不斷加大的競爭壓力，而進軍衛星電話服務之際。本文探討了 AST SpaceMobile 的投資敘述如何受到發射延遲和 SpaceX 在衛星連接方面的激烈競爭的影響。
historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile launch schedule updated
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile and TELUS completed an integration test linking TELUS' terrestrial wireless network with AST SpaceMobile's space based system, aiming to extend direct satellite connectivity for Canadian smartphone users in remote and underserved areas. The push into satellite to phone service comes as AST SpaceMobile faces launch schedule uncertainty and rising competitive pressure from SpaceX in both spectrum access and satellite deployment. This article examines how AST SpaceMobile's investment narrative is affected by launch delays and intensifying SpaceX competition in satellite connectivity.

historyItems.originalTitle: CoreWeave bond rout tests market's math on AI buildout
historyItems.originalSummary: CoreWeave Inc. ( CRWV , Financials ), an AI cloud provider, is becoming a test case of how far investors would go to fund the AI boom.The company's bonds, issued in June at a yield of 9.675%, have plummeted so much that yields are up to around 15%. That's more important than another terrible day for the stock.Credit investors are asking if the cash future data-centre projects will earn will arrive fast enough to support the debt incurred today.The argument is about CoreWeave, which depends significantly on external financing to finance its expansion.Investors are also beginning to look closely at leverage, collateral and the chance that pricey GPUs might become obsolete before certain facilities are up and running.The wider conclusion is that it could be tougher and more expensive to support AI infrastructure.Dan Ives puts the figure of planned projects that may never be constructed at 5% to 10%.That doesn't imply the AI buildout is done, though. It does indicate capital is getting less forgiving.The next thing to monitor is whether CoreWeave bond yields stabilize, since sustained stress might change the price and availability of loans throughout the larger AI infrastructure market.

historyItems.originalTitle: Test: The 2026 Ford F-150 STX Lobo Fails to Impress for the Money
historyItems.originalSummary: Ford makes the long haul and enters Grasso’s Garage with an aesthetically pleasing and proven F-150 Lobo edition pickup truck that is ready for all consumers. With a 600-mile range on a full tank, our F-150 Lobo tester offers an upgraded 5.0-liter Coyote V-8 engine packed with 400 horsepower and 410 lb.-ft. of torque. Paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission, the F-150 Lobo gets up and goes and is smooth. Wrapped in Oxford White, the Lobo package is an additional $4,695 and includes 22-inch gloss black wheels, an electronic locking rear axle and all-season tires. Our STX Series pickup comes with LED fog lights, black cloth interior and a black and dark gray grill. Upgraded options include a tray style floor liner, mobile office package, 36-gallon fuel tank, SiriusXM and spray-in bedliner for a combined additional $2,630 total. While the interior is simple and typical Ford, it serves the consumers well with its 12-inch SYNC4 infotainment system. historyItems.originalTitle: Prediction market odds on Tesla-SpaceX merger are above 50% for early 2027
historyItems.originalSummary: The prediction market odds of a merger between Tesla and SpaceX have risen above 50% for early 2027, according to CNBC. This increase reflects heightened speculation around a possible union of the two companies, both controlled by Elon Musk. Notably, these odds do not stem from any formal announcement or filing, but rather from market activity and sentiment. Recent analyses, including one from Barclays, suggest potential scenarios for a merger, though official confirmations from either company remain absent. Observers should monitor communications from Tesla and SpaceX, particularly any formal disclosures or statements from Elon Musk. An SEC filing or official press release could significantly impact current market pricing. Additionally, regulatory reviews or statements from antitrust authorities may influence the perceived likelihood of a merger. As market participants react to new information, shifts in pricing could further indicate changing expectations.

historyItems.originalTitle: Arista Networks (ANET) Stock Forecast and Price Target 2026

The latest AI rack-scale launch lands after a strong run in Arista Networks' shares, with the stock up 15.51% on a 90-day share price return and 57.84% year to date, while long-term total shareholder return over five years is about 8x. historyItems.title: 隨著從 SpaceX 手中奪取市場份額的努力滑到 2027 年，Rocket Lab 股價暴跌
historyItems.summary: 儘管第二季營收飆升 62%，積壓訂單達到創紀錄的 23.6 億美元，但 Neutron 的推出時間延後到 2027 年後，RKLB 仍下跌 6.6%。這次拋售看起來是針對公司的，ASTS 當天上漲 5.5%，而 IRDM 的收購增加了 2027 年中期收盤時的整合風險。現金流的動機取決於 Neutron 的首次推出以及隨後 18 至 24 個月的車隊投資，但 20 名分析師中有 16 名仍將該股評級為買入。剛剛發布。
historyItems.originalTitle: Rocket Lab stock tumbles as effort to take market share from SpaceX slips to 2027
historyItems.originalSummary: RKLB dropped 6.6% after Neutron's launch slipped to 2027, even as Q2 revenue surged 62% and the backlog hit a record $2.36 billion. The selloff looks company-specific, with ASTS gaining 5.5% that session, while the IRDM acquisition adds integration risk through a mid-2027 close. Cash-flow positivity depends on Neutron's first launch followed by 18 to 24 months of fleet investment, yet 16 of 20 analysts still rate the stock a Buy. Just released. historyItems.originalTitle: Taiwan chipmaker TSMC explores Texas investment to expand production in the US
historyItems.originalSummary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), the world’s largest contract chipmaker, is exploring an expansion into Texas as demand for artificial intelligence chips continues to surge. The company confirmed that it had sent teams to Texas to assess potential investment opportunities. Chairman and CEO C.C. Wei said TSMC was evaluating options to expand its U.S. manufacturing footprint beyond Arizona. “The demand, actually, is still far above our capability today to supply, and we’re working very hard to narrow the gap,” Wei said . READ: Nvidia in talks to acquire Hugging Face for nearly $13 billion (August 27, 2026) The potential Texas investment would be in addition to TSMC’s existing commitment of $265 billion to expand semiconductor manufacturing in the United States, including facilities in Arizona. In July, the company announced an additional $100 billion investment , bringing its total planned U.S. investment to $265 billion. Wei said the investment would help expand the U.S. semiconductor industry, strengthen supply chain resilience and create well-paying jobs in the high-tech sector. TSMC is also discussing a possible role in Elon Musk’s proposed Terafab chip manufacturing complex in Texas. Musk has promoted the project as a way to increase chip production for his businesses, including SpaceX and Tesla. Wei said any factory operated by TSMC would have to remain under the Taiwanese company’s control. Musk, however, has said his companies would build and operate the facility, with TSMC potentially leasing part of it. The companies have not announced a final agreement. TSMC manufactures more than 90% of the world’s most advanced chips and supplies major technology companies, including Apple and Nvidia. As the AI industry’s computing needs grow, semiconductor manufacturers are under increasing pressure to expand production and meet demand. The company’s latest financial results reflect the surge in demand. TSMC reported net profit of 763.1 billion New Taiwan dollars, or about $24 billion, for the July-September quarter, a 69% increase from a year earlier. Revenue rose 51% to 1.49 trillion New Taiwan dollars, or about $46 billion. READ: Nvidia pauses AI cloud financing deals amid control, antitrust concerns (August 28, 2026)

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX Dragon Cargo Mission Approaching Station
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX just delivered some surprisingly strange cargo to the International Space Station, including tiny brain models, 3D heart tissue, and technology for making artificial retinas in space. The shipment also includes materials for creating unusual glass in near weightlessness and the station’s final upgraded solar arrays.

historyItems.originalTitle: Is Analog Devices (ADI) Undervalued On Its Analyst Upgrade And AI Outlook?
historyItems.originalSummary: Is ADI a good stock to buy? We came across a bullish thesis on Analog Devices, Inc. on Astute Optics - US's Substack. The thesis was published on September 11th, when the stock was trading at $378.78, and ADI gained more than 7% since then. The gain appears to reflect improving earnings expectations, supported by recovering industrial demand and expanding AI data center activity across power and optical applications. In this article, we will summarize the bulls' thesis on ADI. Analog Devices, Inc.'s share was trading at $405.93 as of October 8th 2026. ADI's trailing and forward P/E were 45.75 and 23.20 respectively according to Yahoo Finance.

historyItems.originalTitle: Chip-Machine Supplier ASML Boosts Guidance for Third Time on Surging AI Demand
historyItems.originalSummary: By Mauro Orru ASML Holding improved its annual forecasts for the third time this year and said it was looking at ways to boost production of its semiconductor-making machines even more as the race to build artificial-intelligence infrastructure fuels demand for advanced chips. The Dutch group is projecting annual sales between 44 billion euros and 45 billion euros, equivalent to a range of $49.27 billion to $50.39 billion, compared with prior guidance of 43 billion euros to 45 billion euros. Meanwhile, its gross margin--a closely watched metric of pricing power and profitability--should come in at roughly 56%, compared with a previous guidance range of 54% to 56%. The revisions show how much ASML's fortunes have come to benefit from the build-out of data centers that turned chips into a red-hot commodity. Surging semiconductor demand means that ASML's clients like Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Samsung Electronics and Intel will need more of its machines so they can produce enough chips. ASML shares in Amsterdam gained more than 2% in European morning trading, consolidating ASML's lead as Europe's most valuable listed company. Its stock is up more than 80% over the past 12 months on a wave of investor fervor around AI and expectations that chips and semiconductor-making tools will remain in high demand for years to come. "Our customers continue to increase their short- and medium-term equipment demand forecasts with us, driven primarily by their views on the size and duration of AI-related investments. In light of their demand visibility, some customers are expressing an interest in placing orders with us for 2029 and even 2030," ASML Chief Executive Christophe Fouquet said. AI demand pushed up the cost of certain types of chips as companies hoard semiconductors to power data centers, leading to a supply squeeze. Micron Technology Chief Executive Sanjay Mehrotra said last month that supplies of memory and storage chips would be much tighter in the coming years. In a bid to cash in on that tightness, ASML is seeking to increase production of its deep ultraviolet lithography tools as well as its more advanced extreme ultraviolet systems. In July, it had earmarked a 30% boost in 2027 and another 30% in 2028. However, Fouquet said it was becoming clear that wouldn't be enough to meet demand and that ASML was looking at ways to bolster capacity even more, especially for 2028 and beyond. Earlier this year, ASML executives alluded to the possibility of price increases, saying that a tight chip market gave ASML more negotiating power. Finance chief Roger Dassen said that while the company had now completed conversations with key customers, the effect of higher prices wouldn't show on 2026 figures. "It will start to become visible partly in the course of 2027. The full impact of that you will start to see in 2028 and beyond," he said. ASML posted sales of 11.66 billion euros for the third quarter, up from 7.52 billion euros a year earlier. historyItems.title: GlobalFoundries 在美日交易中獲得 210 億美元建廠資金
historyItems.summary: GlobalFoundries Inc 計劃在日本政府高達 210 億美元的支持下建造兩座新的晶片工廠，其中美國還持有該公司 4% 的股份。根據週三宣布的一項協議，GlobalFoundries 將在其位於紐約州北部的工廠運營由美國和日本共同擁有的工廠。這些設施的資金來自日本承諾向美國投資 5,500 億美元的資金。這些工廠將生產所謂的基本晶片，即用於車輛、工業設備和通訊設備的重要但不太複雜的半導體。
historyItems.originalTitle: GlobalFoundries Gets $21 Billion for Plants in US-Japan Deal
historyItems.originalSummary: GlobalFoundries Inc plans to build two new chip plants with the backing of as much as US$21 billion from the Japanese government, part of an arrangement that also includes the US taking a 4 percent stake in the company. Under an agreement announced on Wednesday, GlobalFoundries will operate factories at its site in upstate New York that are jointly owned by the US and Japan. The facilities will be funded with money from Japan’s pledge to invest US$550 billion in the US. The factories will make so-called essential chips, the vital yet less sophisticated semiconductors used in vehicles, industrial equipment and communications gear. Photo: John Carl D’Annibale, The Albany Times Union via AP The GlobalFoundries agreement is meant to boost American production of essential chips and reduce dependence on East Asian suppliers — addressing a national security concern for the US. Under a broader arrangement with GlobalFoundries, the US Department of Commerce will take a roughly 4 percent equity stake in the company, “further enabling the American public to share in GF’s growth.” GlobalFoundries will get to redirect funds from a previous US CHIPS and Science Act grant to invest in honing its manufacturing abilities. That includes advancing its work in fields such as silicon photonics, chip packaging and silicon germanium. In a separate statement, the US Department of Commerce said it was reallocating US$955 million in CHIPS Act incentives to go toward GlobalFoundries’ factory expansion and modernization. As part of the agreement, the company will devote US$5 billion to capital investments at its plants in New York and Vermont. The new Japan-linked factories will be operated in the same way that GlobalFoundries runs its current facilities, which serve customers such as Apple Inc and Japanese firms including Renesas Electronics Corp. Profits will be divided among the owners and GlobalFoundries, following an approach laid out in last year’s US trade deal with Japan. US President Donald Trump touted the accord on his Truth Social site, saying it would help revitalize America’s industrial base and create jobs.
